title: “Bitchin’ Betty” Says Farewell: Beloved Voice Behind Boeing’s F/A-18 Super Hornet Retires
summary: A short Boeing piece on the retirement of the voice behind the F/A-18 Super Hornet cockpit warning system, nicknamed Bitchin' Betty. It touches on why the stern voice alerts are used.
why: Cited as an example of effective alarm and voice-alert design and in discussions of reactions to female voices.

quote.text: one of my favorite examples of this type of work
